WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.brand,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 14

SELECT 'sales' AS t, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines,
       min(sale_date) AS d0, max(sale_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, sum(net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), 0, sum(refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ctl', count(*), count(DISTINCT (business_date, store_id)), 0, min(business_date), max(business_date), 0, sum(net_sales)
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost, f.quantity AS qty
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gm,
           SUM(CASE WHEN n.cost = 0 AND n.qty <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_cost_lines,
           SUM(CASE WHEN n.cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_cost_lines
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, m.net_sales, c.ctl_net, ROUND(m.net_sales - c.ctl_net, 2) AS diff, m.gm, m.zero_cost_lines, m.null_cost_lines
FROM dim_store cs
LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.store_id = cs.store_id
LEFT JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id = cs.store_id
WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.region = 'South'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN abs(f.standard_cost - f.quantity * p.standard_unit_cost) < 0.02 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'mismatch' END AS cost_check,
       CASE WHEN f.quantity < 0 THEN 'negqty' WHEN f.net_amount < 0 THEN 'negnet' ELSE 'normal' END AS shape,
       count(*) AS n, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.standard_cost) AS cost,
       count(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND cs.region = 'South' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region AS region_was, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.region, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin_as_was
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND n.region_was = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
